downloads: none. Every input was restored from git tag archive/research/vol-regime-leverage-v1-2026-10 (data/historical), whose own manifest is research/vol_regime_leverage_v1/DATA_MANIFEST.json and records the Yahoo chart API / FRED / TCMB sources.
restored_with: git checkout archive/research/vol-regime-leverage-v1-2026-10 -- research data/historical (engine research/fast_engine, harness research/band_h2_combo_v1, research/gates_v1 for DSR and provenance)

stress_robustness_v1_daily.csv.content: daily bars with dividends, QQQ (main calendar and K's prices) from 1999-03-10; also SPY, QLD and others, not used by this study beyond the engine's own reads
stress_robustness_v1_daily.csv.used_for: QQQ close and dividends (fe_data.load); QQQ log returns are the HMM observations from 1999-03-11

ewma_band_v1_index.csv.used_for: HMM observation prefix: ^IXIC log returns dated 1990-01-02 to 1999-03-09 (the day before QQQ's first session); OOS window M1 (1975-1999)

stress_robustness_v1_dtb3.csv.used_for: financing and cash return of K (fe_data.load_rates)

ewma_band_v1_tb3ms.csv.used_for: pre-1954 cash rate in the OOS windows (fe_data.load_rates)

hmm_observation_series.main: log returns: ^IXIC closes for dates in [1990-01-01, 1999-03-10), QQQ closes from 1999-03-10 (the first QQQ return is 1999-03-11; the QQQ return on its first session is not used). Training starts 1990-01-01; the first refit is 2000-01-03.
hmm_observation_series.bootstrap: not a new input: the resampled QQQ paths of fe_boot (the main-path final fit's parameters are applied to them)
hmm_observation_series.oos: each OOS window's own closes (log returns), training from the window's first session

sealed_window: not defined in docs/research or WORKER_PROTOCOL.md; no sealed window is applied (see PREREGISTRATION.md)
